name: s3Move
syntax: s3Move(srcBucket, srcObject, trgBucket [, trgObject, acl, accessKeyId, secretKey, host])
description: Moves an object between S3 (or S3-compatible) buckets (or keys) by copying the object and then deleting the source.

params.name: trgObject
params.description: The destination object key. Defaults to the source object key.

params.name: acl
params.description: Object ACL to apply to the move (accepted for compatibility; not enforced).

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: Inline AWS access key id. Overrides credentials from Application.cfc and environment variables.

params.name: host
params.description: Inline endpoint URL for S3-compatible providers (e.g. Cloudflare R2, MinIO).

examples.title: Move an object to another bucket
examples.description: Copies the object to the target and deletes the source.
